summary_en: FY7/26 final dividend raised from ¥6.50 to ¥8.50 per share (+¥2.00, +30.8%), lifting full-year total to ¥15.00 (prior ¥13.00). Shareholder gift eligibility threshold increased from 1,000 to 2,000 shares per reference date; digital-gift amount raised ¥8,000 × 2 annually → ¥10,000 × 2. Subject to TSE approval and October 2026 AGM vote.
title_en: Notice of Revision to FY7/26 Final Dividend Forecast (Increase) and Changes to Shareholder Gift Program
translation_en_brief:
On 10 July 2026, Meiho Enterprise announced a revision to its FY7/26 final dividend forecast and modifications to its shareholder gift program. The company's board approved raising the final dividend from ¥6.50 per share to ¥8.50 per share, an increase of ¥2.00 (+30.8%). This brings the full-year FY7/26 dividend to ¥15.00 per share, compared to the prior forecast of ¥13.00. The revision reflects an upgraded full-year earnings forecast; the company stated that net income attributable to parent-company shareholders is now expected to exceed the previous projection. The company cites its core dividend policy of progressive distributions while balancing internal capital retention for growth.

Concurrently, the company modified its shareholder gift program effective as of the 31 October 2026 reference date. The minimum shareholding threshold for eligibility was raised from 1,000 shares to 2,000 shares per reference date (both October and April). In exchange, the annual digital-gift allowance was increased from ¥8,000 × 2 (¥16,000 annually) to ¥10,000 × 2 (¥20,000 annually). The company stated the changes aim to balance cash dividend returns and gift-based shareholder rewards while deepening shareholder understanding of group operations.

Both the dividend revision and gift-program changes are subject to approval at the company's scheduled ordinary general meeting of shareholders in October 2026.
